comments:
```
    wpa_printf(MSG_ERROR, "curve: %s\n",
               mbedtls_ecp_curve_info_from_grp_id( ecp->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(grp).id )->name );
```
seems to fix the issue :)
who decided to port private/protected/public to outdated C?

Guess it was missed in https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/commit/3b71bd73265de7af7a091838d77ca527cba9aa36#diff-00f66c8d0a1d85eaa2cca3e48beb1703ed613c0586848e5a2fb394165eccc6a4R188

Merging my esp log improvements would also have shown the issue here
